cards.text: Samuel is the LORD's prophet (1 Samuel 3:20), and he's still mourning for Saul, the king the LORD has rejected as king over Israel. So the LORD asks him how long he's going to keep mourning. Then He says, "Fill your horn with oil and go."

cards.question: The LORD tells Samuel He is sending him to Jesse of ___.
The LORD tells Samuel to fill his horn with oil and go to Jesse. Why is He sending Samuel there?

answers.text: He has picked a king from Jesse's sons
He wants Jesse's sons to join the army
He wants Samuel to settle in Jesse's town

cards.text: Samuel asks, "How can I go?" Anointing Saul's replacement while Saul is still king is like interviewing your boss's replacement in the office RIGHT next to his.

cards.question: Samuel asks the LORD how he can go. What does Samuel say Saul will do if he hears about it?

cards.text: The LORD has a plan: take a heifer along and say, "I have come to sacrifice to the LORD." Then invite Jesse to the sacrifice.

cards.question: True or false: the LORD tells Samuel He will show him which son to anoint.

cards.text: So Samuel does what the LORD said and goes to Bethlehem, and the town elders come out to meet him TREMBLING. It's like a police car pulling up behind you, and suddenly EVERYBODY's driving the speed limit.

cards.question: What do the trembling elders of Bethlehem ask Samuel?

answers.text: Who else is coming with you

cards.text: "In peace," Samuel replies, and he tells them he has come to sacrifice to the LORD. Then he says, "Consecrate yourselves and come with me to the sacrifice."

cards.question: Samuel consecrates Jesse for the sacrifice. True or false: Samuel leaves Jesse's sons out of the sacrifice.

cards.text: Jesse and his sons arrive, and Samuel spots Eliab, one of Jesse's sons. Samuel takes ONE look.

cards.question: What does Samuel say when he sees Jesse's son Eliab?

answers.text: Surely this one is the LORD's anointed
Surely this one is too young to lead
Surely this one must offer the sacrifice

cards.text: But the LORD tells Samuel not to consider Eliab's appearance or height, because He has rejected him. Samuel was hiring off the profile picture, and honestly, friend, I'd have hired that profile picture TOO.

cards.question: The LORD says He does not see as man does. Man sees the outward appearance, but what does the LORD see?

cards.text: Then Jesse calls Abinadab, another son, and presents him to Samuel. It's turned into an audition, and Jesse is the agent.

cards.question: True or false: the LORD chooses Jesse's son Abinadab.

cards.text: Next Jesse presents Shammah, and Samuel says the LORD hasn't chosen him either. And Jesse just keeps them coming.

cards.question: Jesse keeps bringing his sons before Samuel. How many of them pass before Samuel?
None of the seven has been chosen. Then Samuel asks Jesse if these are all the ___ he has.

cards.text: Jesse says there's still the youngest, but he's out tending the sheep. Missing the big moment? Friend, I spent YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, so I FEEL that.

cards.question: Samuel tells Jesse to send for his youngest son. True or false: Samuel says they won't sit down to eat until the youngest arrives.

cards.text: So Jesse sends for his youngest son and brings him in, ruddy, with beautiful eyes and a handsome appearance. Hold on, Eliab had the looks too, and we saw how THAT went.

cards.question: Jesse's youngest son walks in. What does the LORD tell Samuel?

answers.text: Send him back to the field

cards.text: So Samuel takes the horn of oil and anoints him right in front of his brothers. And the youngest finally gets his name in the story: David.

cards.question: Samuel has anointed David. From that day forward, what rushes upon David?

cards.text: Then Samuel sets out and goes to Ramah. Hang on, friend, because this story is just getting STARTED.
